_doc: 519 M1: reviewed calls for refused names the rules in m1_score.py cannot place (key: child|name). call: stray = another body's name (a rehome candidate when its holder also carries admitted names); noise = the parent body's own name that child_check refuses (S1 / ruling 2); site = a trust site's own site or service name (513's 'hosted sites stay separate').
